summary: The implementation covers all 10 requirements with comprehensive frontend sections and backend functionality. The design uses Deep Forest Green and Desert Sand colors as specified. All required images are referenced correctly. The volunteer portal, blog section, and species showcase are fully implemented with backend integration. However, REQ-1's video autoplay feature is not implemented—only a static background image is used.

missing_requirements.requirement: Background video element showing Atlas Mountains imagery with autoplay functionality and appropriate fallback
missing_requirements.reason: The Hero component uses only a static background image (/assets/generated/atlas-mountains-hero.dim_1920x1080.png) with no video element, autoplay, or fallback mechanism implemented
